description: List the projects of the connected project's workspace, to pick one for bind_agent_project. Each shows its id and name, whether it is this connection's own project, and whether this connection can connect it to an agent: a project you created, or any project of a team you are an admin of. No keys are shown. With agent_guid the result also says which listed project that agent uses.

agent_guid.description: A deployed agent's guid, from list_my_agents, to see which listed project it uses.

name: list_projects

project.description: none: the agent has no project. listed: it uses one of these. this_connection: it uses the project of this connection, which is not among these. outside_list: it uses a project key from outside this list, or one this connection cannot see.

boundToAgent.description: With agent_guid: whether that agent uses this project.

canBind.description: Whether this connection can connect the project to an agent with bind_agent_project.

ipRestricted.description: Whether the project accepts requests only from the addresses on its IP list.

title: List Wiro projects
